issues.title: Cents shown three different ways on Home
issues.detail: The same widget family mixes superscript cents, inline cents and abbreviated amounts. Accounts rows show '$200,000.00' with superscript cents, but the hover tooltip for that same row shows '$200,000.00' inline; the Disputes widget shows '$3,444.23' inline; the balance table's 'Pending transfers $71,764.10' is inline while its siblings are superscript; the Invoicing widget puts 'Overdue 4 · $950.00' (superscript) next to 'Paid 12 · $6K' and 'Open 12 items · $12.3K' (abbreviated). Search results and the payment review hero ('$1,042.95', 34px Arcadia Display) also drop the superscript used by the Home hero.
issues.evidence: Accounts row: span._superscript_1of3b_35 (15px parent, 10.95px sup, top -2.9px). Hero: 28px Arcadia Display, sup 20.44px. Pending transfers: 13px, fraction span has no _superscript class. Disputes '$3,444.23 at 3 merchants': plain 12px text node. Search '$1,952.15': 15px, fraction span with empty class. Payment review: span._titleHero_qaod7_12 34px/380 plain text '$1,042.95'.

issues.title: Modal buttons come from two different button components
issues.detail: The 'Customize the Mercury demo' modal uses a different button implementation from every other modal, and 'Cancel' is styled three ways across Home dialogs: tinted pill with blue text, transparent text-only, and tinted pill with grey text at a smaller height.
issues.evidence: Customize demo: classes _button_1rzdg_13 _tertiary_1rzdg_76/_primary_1rzdg_101 _small_1rzdg_88, radius 28px, h40, padding 8px 32px, label 15px/480; Cancel bg rgba(180,183,200,.12) color rgb(141,164,245). Create account: _button_r6b2u_20 _large_r6b2u_88 _tertiary_r6b2u_153, radius 9999px, h40, Cancel bg transparent color rgb(221,221,229). Feedback panel: _button_r6b2u_20 _small_r6b2u_72 _secondary_r6b2u_126, radius 9999px, h32, Cancel bg rgba(180,183,200,.12) color rgb(221,221,229).

issues.title: Dimmed primary buttons are sometimes disabled, sometimes not
issues.detail: 'Submit', 'Create account' and 'Share feedback' all render at 40% opacity before the form is valid. 'Share feedback' is truly disabled, but 'Submit' and 'Create account' stay clickable and run validation, with no disabled or aria-disabled signal. Identical visuals, two behaviors.
issues.evidence: Customize demo Submit: opacity 0.4, disabled=false, aria-disabled null, class _disabled_1rzdg_20. Create account: opacity 0.4, disabled=false, class _appearDisabled_r6b2u_16; click shows 'You must make a selection.'. Share feedback: opacity 0.4, disabled=true, class _appearDisabled_r6b2u_16.

issues.title: Validation messages use different voice and punctuation
issues.detail: The Customize demo form says 'Please complete this field' / 'Please submit a valid email' (polite, no period) while Create account says 'You must make a selection.' (imperative, trailing period). The Customize form also flags Industry as incomplete while its placeholder 'Startup' reads like a selected value.
issues.evidence: Customize demo, empty Submit: six 'Please complete this field' messages, 12px/400 rgb(252,146,180); email 'bad@' gives 'Please submit a valid email'. Industry input role=combobox has placeholder 'Startup' and empty value. Create account error: 'You must make a selection.' 12px rgb(252,146,180), classes _tiny_qaod7_67 _text-error_12t49_1 _defaultErrorMessage_1tnh5_25.

issues.title: Empty states have no shared pattern
issues.detail: Updates shows a lone 13px 'No updates' line; Tasks > Completed shows skeleton ghost rows, a 17px title and 15px body; Search with no matches shows no empty message at all, only a 'Search all transactions' row.
issues.evidence: Updates: 'No updates' 13px/400 rgb(221,221,229) under a 17px/400 title. Tasks: 'No completed tasks' 17px/400 #fff + 'You don’t have any completed tasks yet.' 15px/400 rgb(221,221,229) over skeleton rows. Search: only an option 'Search all transactions for "zzqxnothing"'.

issues.title: Same date written three ways in the approval flow
issues.detail: The Tasks list shows 'Sep 23', the invite review sentence says 'on Sep 23, 2026', and the payment review shows 'Initiated on September 24, 2026'. Home widgets use 'Sep 29' and chart axes 'Aug 30'. The balance graph hover header says 'September 14, 2026' above an axis labelled 'Sep 14'. Times differ too: transaction drawers print 'Sep 23 at 5:12PM', the reimbursement panel 'Jul 4th at 5:00pm' (ordinal suffix, lowercase pm), and Command bubbles '5:31 PM' (with a space).
issues.evidence: DOM text: Tasks 'Received' cell 'Sep 23'; invite copy '...to Mercury Demo on Sep 23, 2026.'; payment review 'Initiated on' value 'September 24, 2026'. Graph hover header leaf 'September 13, 2026' (varies with pointer) 15px/400 rgb(244,245,249); axis tick 'Sep 14'. Drawer text 'Sep 23 at 5:12PM'; reimbursement panel 'Jul 4th at 5:00pm — by Jessica Awad' with 'Date of expense Jul 5, 2024'; Command timestamp '5:31 PM'.

issues.title: Adjacent badges use different treatments
issues.detail: On the invite review, the 'Admin' role badge is outlined while the card 'Pending' badges are filled, at the same size and color. The dashboard 'Failed' badge is a third, pink outlined variant.
issues.evidence: 'Admin': 12px, parent border 1px solid rgba(180,183,200,.2), bg transparent, radius 4px, padding 0 8px. 'Pending': 12px, parent bg rgba(180,183,200,.28), no border, radius 4px, padding 0 8px. Dashboard 'Failed': 12px rgb(252,146,180), border 1px solid rgba(252,146,180,.36), bg transparent, radius 4px.

issues.title: Empty-value dash rendered in two colors
issues.detail: On the invite review, 'Department -' and 'Leading departments -' sit in the same list but the first dash is white and the second grey. Home's Bill Pay 'Due soon -' also uses a bare hyphen rather than an em dash or 'None'.
issues.evidence: Two '-' leaf nodes: rgb(255,255,255) 14px and rgb(157,157,168) 14px.

issues.title: Task descriptions emphasize entities inconsistently
issues.detail: Some task rows bold the counterparty ('Jason Green', 'Bruce Collins', 'Monarch Books', 'Jane Black', 'Hardware', 'Jessica Awad', 'The Bayside Bistro') while equivalent entities stay regular ('Landon Shepherd' as subject or requester, 'Uber Eats', 'Alice C.'). Only the Monarch Books row ends with a period.
issues.evidence: Leaf spans at font-weight ≥480 per row: 'Monarch Books'; 'Jane Black'/'Hardware'; 'Bruce Collins'; 'Jason Green' (×2); 'Jessica Awad'/'The Bayside Bistro'. None in the Uber Eats, receipts, daily maximum and dual admin rows. 'Landon Shepherd' and 'Alice C.' at 400. Row 2 text ends 'Monarch Books.'; other rows have no terminal period.

issues.title: Private Mode reveals amount magnitude

Receipt exemption: 'Reject' (ghost) then 'Approve exception' as a grey secondary button, so the approve action has no primary color. The negative verb switches between Decline and Reject.

Search suggestions list both 'Failed Transaction' and 'Failed transaction', 'Transfer Limit' and 'Transfer limit', 'Prohibited Countries' and 'Prohibited countries'.
